title: Predicting amplification of MYCN using CpG methylation biomarkers in neuroblastoma.
authors: Giwa, Abdulazeez; Rossouw, Sophia Catherine; Fatai, Azeez; Gamieldien, Junaid; Christoffels, Alan; Bendou, Hocine
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CpG甲基化标志物和机器学习预测神经母细胞瘤中MYCN扩增，属于纯表观遗传生物标志物分类，无蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Background: Neuroblastoma is the most common extracranial solid tumor in childhood. Amplification of MYCN in neuroblastoma is a predictor of poor prognosis. Materials and methods: DNA methylation data from the TARGET data matrix were stratified into MYCN amplified and non-amplified groups. Differential methylation analysis, clustering, recursive feature elimination (RFE), machine learning (ML), Cox regression analysis and Kaplan-Meier estimates were performed. Results and Conclusion: 663 CpGs were differentially methylated between the two groups. A total of 25 CpGs were selected by RFE for clustering and ML, and a 100% clustering accuracy was obtained. ML validation on three external datasets produced high accuracy scores of 100%, 97% and 93%. Eight survival-associated CpGs were also identified. Therapeutic interventions may need to be targeted to patient subgroups.
abstract_zh: 背景：神经母细胞瘤是儿童期最常见的颅外实体肿瘤。神经母细胞瘤中MYCN的扩增是预后不良的预测因子。材料与方法：来自TARGET数据矩阵的DNA甲基化数据被分为MYCN扩增组和非扩增组。进行了差异甲基化分析、聚类、递归特征消除（RFE）、机器学习（ML）、Cox回归分析和Kaplan-Meier估计。结果与结论：两组间共有663个CpG位点存在差异甲基化。通过RFE筛选出25个CpG位点用于聚类和ML，聚类准确率达到100%。在三个外部数据集上的ML验证产生了100%、97%和93%的高准确率分数。还鉴定出8个与生存相关的CpG位点。治疗干预可能需要针对患者亚群进行。
